summary.en-US: A modern imageboard companion with powerful local content filters and keyboard navigation.
summary.ru: Современный помощник для имиджборд с локальными фильтрами и клавиатурной навигацией.

description.en-US: Dollchan Next is an independent, modernised fork of Dollchan Extension Tools. It improves imageboard navigation, posting, media handling and local content filtering. External media services are disabled until explicitly enabled.
description.ru: Dollchan Next — независимый, существенно переработанный форк Dollchan Extension Tools. Он улучшает навигацию, постинг, работу с медиа и локальную фильтрацию контента. Внешние медиасервисы отключены до явного согласия.

version.approval_notes: Independent MIT-licensed fork with substantial filtering, hotkey, privacy, UI and build changes. Build with Node.js 22: npm ci && npm run verify. The submitted package contains no remote executable code. Optional YouTube/Vimeo metadata and image-search integrations are disabled by default and require an explicit in-product opt-in. Full data-flow documentation is included in PRIVACY.md; dynamic markup boundaries are classified in AMO_REVIEW.md. Human-readable source is uploaded with this submission.
